grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or a basic staple such as eggs, flour, milk, feta and oil.

supermarket.reason: Spring greens, feta, watercress and radishes are all everyday supermarket items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a bowl and a whisk, and the frying technique suits a beginner.

works.reason: 250g greens bound with 3 eggs, 100g self-raising flour and 150g feta makes a thick batter and about a dozen fritters, which with the salad is a fair lunch for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers shredding, slicing, zesting and mixing, and 15 minutes fits the wilting plus frying in a couple of batches.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used, the lemon supplies both zest and juice, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: Spring greens make up the bulk of the fritters, and a light fritter-and-cress lunch suits early April.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Greens, eggs and feta with a fresh salad make a balanced lunch a family would happily eat again.
